sql: SELECT "player_award_vote"."player_id" AS e, "player"."death_country" AS g, SUM("player_award_vote"."votes_first") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("player_award_vote"."points_won" - "player_award_vote"."points_max") AS REAL) / "player_award_vote"."points_max")) AS m2 FROM "player_award_vote" JOIN "player" ON "player"."player_id" = "player_award_vote"."player_id"  GROUP BY "player_award_vote"."player_id", "player"."death_country" ORDER BY m2 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: player_award_vote.relative difference of voting points won from maximum possible points
why: total of first-place votes per player within player.death_country (additive)
(voting points won - maximum possible points) / maximum possible points: the relative difference of two quantities in points
average of relative difference of voting points won from maximum possible points per player within player.death_country

sql: SELECT "player"."throws" AS g, SUM(("batting_postseason"."rbi" - "batting_postseason"."so")) AS m1, AVG((CAST(("batting_postseason"."ibb" - "batting_postseason"."g") AS REAL) / "batting_postseason"."g")) AS m2 FROM "batting_postseason" JOIN "player" ON "player"."player_id" = "batting_postseason"."player_id" GROUP BY "player"."throws"
quantities: batting_postseason.relative difference of intentional walks from games played
why: runs batted in - strikeouts: both in count and of the same kind (flows) on the same player batting line per postseason round
total of runs batted in minus strikeouts per player.throws (additive)
(intentional walks - games played) / games played: the relative difference of two quantities in count
average of relative difference of intentional walks from games played per player.throws

sql: SELECT "player"."bats" AS g, SUM(("appearances"."g_all" - "appearances"."g_p")) AS m1, AVG(("appearances"."g_of" - "appearances"."g_ss")) AS m2, (SUM(("appearances"."g_all" - "appearances"."g_p")) - AVG(("appearances"."g_of" - "appearances"."g_ss"))) AS m3 FROM "appearances" JOIN "player" ON "player"."player_id" = "appearances"."player_id" GROUP BY "player"."bats"
quantities: appearances.games in outfield minus games at shortstop
appearances.games played minus games as pitcher
why: games played - games as pitcher: both in count and of the same kind (flows) on the same player-team-season
total of games played minus games as pitcher per player.bats (additive)
games in outfield - games at shortstop: both in count and of the same kind (flows) on the same player-team-season
average of games in outfield minus games at shortstop per player.bats
total of games played minus games as pitcher minus average of games in outfield minus games at shortstop: both in count, of the same kind, from different quantities

sql: SELECT "appearances"."player_id" AS e, "player"."death_country" AS g, SUM(("appearances"."g_1b" - "appearances"."g_cf")) AS m1, AVG(("appearances"."g_lf" - "appearances"."gs")) AS m2, (SUM(("appearances"."g_1b" - "appearances"."g_cf")) - AVG(("appearances"."g_lf" - "appearances"."gs"))) AS m3 FROM "appearances" JOIN "player" ON "player"."player_id" = "appearances"."player_id"  GROUP BY "appearances"."player_id", "player"."death_country" ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: appearances.games at first base minus games in center field
appearances.games in left field minus games started
why: games at first base - games in center field: both in count and of the same kind (flows) on the same player-team-season
total of games at first base minus games in center field per player within player.death_country (additive)
games in left field - games started: both in count and of the same kind (flows) on the same player-team-season
average of games in left field minus games started per player within player.death_country
total of games at first base minus games in center field minus average of games in left field minus games started: both in count, of the same kind, from different quantities

sql: SELECT "home_game"."park_id" AS e, "park"."state" AS g, AVG((CAST(("home_game"."openings" - "home_game"."games") AS REAL) / "home_game"."games")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "home_game" JOIN "park" ON "park"."park_id" = "home_game"."park_id"  GROUP BY "home_game"."park_id", "park"."state" ORDER BY m2 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: home_game.relative difference of home openings (dates with games) from home games
why: (home openings (dates with games) - home games) / home games: the relative difference of two quantities in count
average of relative difference of home openings (dates with games) from home games per park within park.state
